objective: Synthesize P/N/E assemblies from source-derived interfaces carrying transport, occupied/reference support and configuration guards.
governing_conjecture: A finite interface calculus extracted from bounded native paths, with explicit support permissions and reader guards, is sound and complete for the declared construction grammar and supports compositional structural synthesis.

semantics.budget: Maximum absolute realization origin, never total operations.
semantics.interface: Endpoint packets and occurrences, full coefficient transport, native factor path, reference support, required occupied/vacant support, configuration guard and permission provenance.
semantics.permission: Transport derivation and occupancy permission are separate fields; each interface names the premise authorizing its support change.
semantics.composition: Recompute guards and all-selected-record root/exit/contact obligations on the full selected configuration.
semantics.scope: Marked reference constructions and structural synthesis.
semantics.resolved_scoped: Evidence covers the explicitly recorded finite domain; broader conjectures remain open.
semantics.depends_on: Research prerequisites, not imported truth. Test jobs may target a frozen subcase before a broad prerequisite is resolved.

conjectures.title: Source-derived marked path interfaces
conjectures.statement: Bounded native paths admit canonical interface records retaining every distinction needed for transport and guarded continuation.
conjectures.acceptance: Extract interfaces from all simple native paths in the frozen test domain; reproduce every factor and composed map; identify records only when endpoints, origins, references, support and guards agree.
conjectures.falsifier: An identified pair differs in full map, required support, occurrence or an enabled continuation.

conjectures.title: Occupied versus reference-only support
conjectures.statement: Support requirements can be expressed as explicit interface predicates, with native occupancy and terminal-PE contraction as the first two admitted policies.
conjectures.acceptance: Produce a support table with required occupied/vacant/reference sites, derive guard consequences, and compare policies on the same transported interfaces. Each additional support permission is separately named and tested.
conjectures.falsifier: Transport-equivalent interfaces require different permissions or an omitted environment condition changes admission.

conjectures.title: Composition of conditional interfaces
conjectures.statement: Interface composition with complete-set guard re-evaluation agrees with direct source path and configuration audits.
conjectures.acceptance: Enumerate compatible interface pairs and triples, preserving full maps and provenance; compare all composition orders, including shortcut disabling by added support or successors.
conjectures.falsifier: Individually admitted interfaces compose to a bad map, missing face witness, unrooted record or stale guard.

conjectures.title: Interface synthesis reconstructs the atlas
conjectures.statement: Interface-driven assembly synthesis generates exactly the complete selected-state and labelled-history graphs of the declared grammar at each tested origin budget.
conjectures.acceptance: Match states, labelled transitions, exits and rejected controls against independent complete small atlases; preserve revisits and report resource stops separately.
conjectures.falsifier: A state, transition, exit certificate or rejected configuration differs between implementations.
resolved_subcases: terminal-PE D0/1 explicit versus exhaustive subsets versus guarded Boolean

conjectures.title: Explain successful and blocked placements
conjectures.statement: Support and reader-connectivity obstructions distinguish successful structures from equal-composition failures and guide construction of alternatives.
conjectures.acceptance: Extract checkable obstruction certificates from failed placements; use them to propose a different interface placement and validate the resulting construction from the seed.
conjectures.falsifier: The proposed discriminator predicts a certificate contradicted by direct construction, or merely restates the full acceptance test without guiding synthesis.

conjectures.title: Compositional P/N/E structural synthesis
conjectures.statement: The interface calculus constructs admissible P/N/E structures and explains placement-dependent success using transport, support and reader guards.
conjectures.acceptance: Assemble the five branch deliverables with compatible source and mode conventions.
conjectures.falsifier: The branch results cannot compose under one declared grammar and interface representation.

domain.paths: All simple directed native operation paths; parallel operation labels retained.
domain.sources: Every packet in each complete origin-bounded universe.

procedure: Extract complete endpoint/map/occurrence/reference-support records for every path.
Partition terminal P-to-E paths by grade and exact shared interface.
Replay all factors and full map compositions independently.
Test the candidate classification: same-origin P-to-E paths with only internal N packets are exactly PN then NE in this domain.
Retain counterexamples to endpoint-shape-only and terminality-only identification.
Export a candidate interface catalog with occupied/reference/vacant support and permission provenance; leave unadmitted contractions as candidates.
tests.completion: A hashed catalog, exact classification counts or counterexamples, and independent factor/map checks. Update node dispositions and choose the next test from the result.
